articles.title: Samsung Galaxy Watch9 Review: Too Many Health Scores, Not Enough Battery
articles.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Watch9 adds new health scores for your heart, sleep, and fitness. It starts at $80 and lasts about 25 hours per charge. But our reviewer wonders if all that data is actually useful.

articles.title: From Nervous Debut to Davis Cup Hero: Samuel's Stunning Win
articles.summary: Samuel won his Davis Cup debut after Cameron Norrie withdrew with an injury. He fought back from a set down to win 4-6, 6-4, 6-1. Britain leads 2-0.

articles.title: Afghanistan: Kite Fights, Silk Road, and Snow Leopards
articles.summary: Afghanistan is a Central Asian country of tall mountains and dry deserts. Kids there have kite fights with wire or glass strings. Endangered snow leopards live in the cold Hindu Kush.
